entries.title: Proverbs 10:1
segments: ¶The Proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; but a foolish son is the grief of his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:2
segments: ¶Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; but righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:3
segments: Jehovah suffereth not the soul of the righteous [man] to famish; but he repelleth the craving of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:4
segments: ¶He cometh to want that dealeth with a slack hand; but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:5
segments: ¶He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:6
segments: ¶Blessings are upon the head of a righteous [man]; but the mouth of the wicked covereth violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:7
segments: ¶The memory of the righteous [man] shall be blessed; but the name of the wicked shall rot.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:8
segments: ¶The wise in heart receiveth commandments; but a prating fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:9
segments: ¶He that walketh in integrity walketh securely; but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:10
segments: ¶He that winketh with the eye causeth grief, and a prating fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:11
segments: ¶The mouth of a righteous [man] is a fountain of life; but the mouth of the wicked covereth violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:12
segments: ¶Hatred stirreth up strifes; but love covereth all transgressions.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:13
segments: ¶In the lips of an intelligent [man] wisdom is found; but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:14
segments: ¶The wise lay up knowledge; but the mouth of the fool is near destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:15
segments: ¶The rich man's wealth is his strong city; the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:16
segments: ¶The labour of a righteous [man] [tendeth] to life; the revenue of a wicked [man], to sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:17
segments: ¶Keeping instruction is the path to life; but he that forsaketh reproof goeth astray.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:18
segments: ¶He that covereth hatred hath lying lips, and he that sendeth forth a slander is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:19
segments: ¶In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; but he that restraineth his lips doeth wisely.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:20
segments: ¶The tongue of the righteous [man] is [as] choice silver; the heart of the wicked is little worth.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:21
segments: The lips of a righteous [man] feed many; but fools die for want of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:22
segments: ¶The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow to it.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:23
segments: ¶It is as sport to a foolish [man] to do wickedness; but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:24
segments: ¶The fear of a wicked [man], it shall come upon him; but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:25
segments: As a whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no [more]; but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:26
segments: ¶As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:27
segments: ¶The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:28
segments: The hope of the righteous is joy; but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:29
segments: ¶The way of Jehovah is strength to the perfect [man], but destruction to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:30
segments: The righteous [man] shall never be moved; but the wicked shall not inhabit the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:31
segments: ¶The mouth of a righteous [man] putteth forth wisdom; but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:32
segments: The lips of a righteous [man] know what is acceptable; but the mouth of the wicked is frowardness.
